effectiveOn: merge of the independently reviewed #1261 amendment
runsPerArmMeaning: scheduled fresh runs per task per arm, not replacements until enough successes

precision.method: two-sided weighted Hoeffding bounds; union bound over two estimands
precision.coverageAssumption: independent fresh-run outcomes under the registered conditions; not verified by an identifier alone

shapeRealizationRate.cells: the three selected tasks crossed with both policies

armAEscapeRate.cells: the three selected tasks under A
armAEscapeRate.denominator: eligible runs within each cell, including non-building declared-done states
armAEscapeRate.outcome: built declared-done state with the registered genuine held-out effect failure; not conditioned on realized shape

missingness.invalidAttempts: retained separately, never replaced after outcomes are inspected
missingness.unscorableOutcome: the affected estimand is unidentified, not zero or silently excluded
missingness.attrition: use actual eligible cell counts and fixed equal cell weights; disclose wider precision

nullResultAcceptance: not separately recorded from the maintainer
